## The problem

Planners often need a fast first look at what infrastructure exists around a location (hospitals, fuel, power, bridges) from open data that is available anywhere. Commercial or classified geospatial holdings may not cover every location or may not be releasable.

## Approach

The app sends Overpass API queries for OSM amenity nodes within 1 km of a user-set point and Nominatim reverse geocoding. Results appear in a table and on an interactive folium map with drawing and measurement controls.

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple"}
## Why it matters for a decision

Potential: first-look infrastructure IPB (intelligence preparation of the battlefield) or HA/DR site assessment (facility inventory, nearest-facility distance, with coverage caveats). Currently it supports no specific decision; the analysis layer is not built.
:::

## Results

| Result | Evidence |
|---|---|
| Queries live OSM data through the Overpass API for amenities near a point, and reverse-geocodes through Nominatim | app.py / app_fixed.py Execute Query handler (Overpass node[amenity](around:1000); Nominatim /reverse) |
| Interactive drawing and distance/area measurement on the map | folium plugins.Draw and plugins.MeasureControl in app.py |

Every result above is traced to a script, log, or artifact in the repository. See [How I Check My Work](/approach.qmd).

## Limitations

- The heatmap is 100 uniformly random points around the map centre, not data.
- Queries return nodes only: facilities mapped as ways or relations (most hospitals, schools, parks) are missed. 'park' queries the wrong key (amenity instead of leisure).
- The query radius is fixed at 1 km, results are silently cut to 20, and the 'Search Location' option has no handler.
- OSM completeness varies by region. No data timestamp or coverage caveat is shown.
- Drawn shapes are not read back, so no analysis runs on user areas.
- The public app.py still offers deprecated Stamen tiles (3 of 6 styles). The fix exists only in the unversioned app_fixed.py.
- Dependencies are unpinned and the code has no license.
